title: The Meteorite Older Than Earth
short_teaser: Some meteorites contain material formed before Earth itself.
story: Some meteorites contain material formed before Earth itself. Holding one means holding evidence from the early solar system. An ordinary-looking stone can carry a history far beyond human scale. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective. It reminds us that the world still contains more than we have noticed. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: An ordinary-looking stone can carry a history far beyond human scale. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective. It reminds us that the world still contains more than we have noticed.
